learning_objective: Năm box đầy với hidden ở đáy, một box trống, capacity bằng sáu box
warnings: Kiểm tra cấu trúc không đảm bảo màn chơi có lời giải. Hãy chơi thử trong Play Mode.
wait_policy: Wait for launch, landing, lock and surprise animations; allow conveyor circulation before the next click.
challenge_intent: Practice learned mechanics with capacity scaled to box count.
difficulty_limitations: Reference length and mechanic counts are content filters, not minimum moves or measured human difficulty. Boosters remain optional.
peak_limitations: Settled-state samples only; transient peak requires Unity measurement.
runtime_context: Isolated Play Mode fixture, actual GameController.OnClickBox and animations; tutorial bypassed; accelerated replay is not human balance measurement.
runtime_wait_policy: Wait for the reference settled state or two conveyor circuits plus animation margin. Replan from a paused snapshot of the actual settled board on divergence (max 12 replans, 300 legal clicks). Require legal clicks and natural final win; no boosters or board edits. Replay wall time includes planning pauses.
lifecycle_scope: Replay during launch; disable/enable during launch followed by replay; multiple-pair boards prefer a ready later pair. Initial state and every cable binding restored, with no null/missing-reference/disposed exceptions observed. Does not certify every interruption frame.
